Ref No. SECI/C&P/IPP/13/0002/26-27/Amendment-01 Date: 17.07.2026 Amendment-01 to RfS for Selection of RE Power Developers under Contract for Difference (CfD) Mechanism for assured Peak Supply of 1000 MWh (500 MW x 2 Hrs.) from ISTS-Connected RE Projects in India under Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (SECI-CfD-I) RfS No. SECI/C&P/IPP/13/0002/26-27 dated 15.07.2026
S. No.
Clause/
Article No.
Existing Clause/Article Amended Clause/Article Amendments in the RfS document 1.
1.9 Addendum to the Clause SECI will maintain the pool for the complete Term of the CfDA, and in case the pool accrual at any given time during this tenure becomes zero/negative, SECI will replenish it with an appropriate amount from its own resources. 2. 9.3.a.iv Addendum to the Clause Notwithstanding the gain/loss sharing ratios specified above, for any Time-Block where the MCP exceeds Rs. 10/kWh, the incremental profit/gain attributable to the portion of MCP in excess of Rs. 10/kWh, i.e., corresponding to (MCP – Rs. 10/kWh), shall be shared between the CfD Pool and RPD in the ratio of 50:50.
For avoidance of doubt, the gain/loss corresponding to MCP up to Rs. 10/kWh shall continue to be shared in accordance with the slab-wise sharing ratios specified above.
Illustration:
For a particular Time-Block, if the SP is Rs. 5.7/kWh and the MCP is Rs. 12/kWh, the total gain amounts to Rs. 6.3/kWh (i.e., Rs. 12/kWh – Rs. 5.7/kWh).
Out of the above, the gain corresponding to MCP up to Rs. 10/kWh, i.e., Rs. 4.3/kWh (Rs. 10/kWh – Rs. 5.7/kWh), shall be shared in accordance with the applicable slab-wise sharing ratio. Since the MCP of Rs. 12/kWh falls under Slab-3, such gain shall be shared between the CfD Pool and the RPD in the ratio of 30:70, resulting in Rs. 1.29/kWh being credited to the CfD Pool and Rs. 3.01/kWh accruing to the RPD.
The incremental gain attributable to the portion of MCP exceeding Rs. 10/kWh, i.e., Rs. 2.0/kWh (Rs. 12/kWh – Rs. 10/kWh), shall be shared between the CfD Pool and the RPD in the ratio of 50:50, resulting in Rs. 1.0/kWh being credited to the CfD Pool and Rs. 1.0/kWh accruing to the RPD.
Accordingly, the total amount credited to the CfD Pool shall be Rs. 2.29/kWh, while the total amount accruing to the RPD shall be Rs. 4.01/kWh.
